'''Crystallized Estus''' is a light-emitting block that replaces {{MCW|Glowstone|glowstone}}. It is the block form of [[Estus Ash]] and works exactly like vanilla glowstone.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The vanilla recipe is unchanged: four Estus Ash make one block.

=== Natural generation ===
Crystallized Estus generates on the ceilings of [[Hell]] (the Nether) as glowstone does in vanilla. Breaking it drops 2–4 Estus Ash, or the block itself with Silk Touch.
